note: Two vty ranges (0-4, 5-15) have genuinely different transport input policies. A single-scalar telnet.enabled field cannot represent both without loss. app/deterministic_extractor.py's cisco_scalars.textfsm uses Filldown (last-directive-wins), so it resolves this to telnet.enabled=ENABLED (the fail-safe direction: it correctly flags SOME telnet exposure) but silently loses that vty 0-4 is properly SSH-only. This is not scored as a pass/fail extraction accuracy case — there is no single correct scalar answer — it is a fixture for measuring whether the live pipeline's confidence/agreement signals (parsing_confidence, parser_agreement) drop enough on this input to actually route it toward human_review, per docs/Suggestions.md §6's 'Ambiguous configuration -> Expected human review' class.
